rules.title: Cambridge Tenant Relocation Assistance Ordinance - Relocation payment
rules.requirement: When a landlord terminates a tenancy for any reason other than nonpayment of rent, the landlord shall pay each displaced tenant household a relocation payment equal to two months of rent within 10 days after the notice is delivered.

coverage_conditions.summary: Residential buildings in Cambridge, MA with 6 or more units.

rules.exemptions: This chapter does not apply to buildings owned by the City of Cambridge or by the Cambridge Housing Authority.

rules.title: Cambridge Tenant Relocation Assistance Ordinance - Notice of termination
rules.requirement: A landlord must give a tenant written notice at least 90 days before the date on which the landlord will evict the tenant or otherwise end the tenancy under Section 8.99.030.

rules.title: Cambridge Tenant Relocation Assistance Ordinance - Return of security deposit
rules.requirement: A landlord shall return the full security deposit of a displaced tenant household within 10 days after the tenant vacates the unit, and may not deduct the cost of ordinary wear and tear.
